published_sdk_direct_json_failure.status: Known uncorrected upstream limitation; not certified by happy-path acceptance
published_sdk_direct_json_failure.description: Direct JSON-file failure cleanup can raise AttributeError str has no attribute value and mask the original task exception. Input.fail stores exception type as string; helper uses split arguments while _DirectFileAdapter expects enum.value. SDK0.5.0 alone is not a fix.
published_sdk_direct_json_failure.contract_bound: Core1.1.0 declares no actions-work-items minimum; no blanket ABI claim. Directory/dict FileAdapter is a distinct exception= contract and was not substituted.
published_sdk_direct_json_failure.safe_handling: A failure is not success or proof of nonexecution. Do not blindly retry or clear uncertain work from the secondary error.

windows_runtime_reload_recovery: Fail-closed unavailable: process-identity verifier remains Linux-only. Live-terminal startup/stop separately passed.
generic_managed_invocation_recovery: No generic original-request lookup; unknown invocation remains uncertain and blocks replacement mutations;404 is not nonexecution proof.
mac: No extension or new Runtime Mac artifact in this release
legacy_holotree_archive: Isolated legacy shared archive export remains unsupported
